message:
Browser dev-build console, while loading the homepage's "Selected work" section, logs 6 React warnings:

Encountered two children with the same key, `[Outcome — what changed.]`. Keys should be unique so that components maintain their identity across updates. Non-unique keys may cause children to be duplicated and/or omitted — the behavior is unsupported and could change in a future version.

QA noticed this while reviewing the homepage in a local dev build; the page still renders, but the warning repeats 6 times in a row.
